guide.timeRaw: 30 hours if doing trophy-relevant tasks only and playing on story difficulty, ignoring all other side tasks (~50% overall completion required) / 40 hours if playing on Normal and doing more side tasks than needed
guide.missablesRaw: 1 –   All Machine Types Scanned ( Specter  &  Specter Prime  are missable scans, they only spawn during quests and don’t have open world spawns. Both can be found in final main story quest " Singularity ". Especially the endboss is a highly missable scan, only appears one time in the game and if you die during the boss fight you must rescan it). *As of Patch 1.08 "Specter Prime" gets added to database automatically if missed. "Specter" is still missable but as of Patch 1.16 can be scanned in New Game+ if missed and also appears in the Burning Shores DLC main quests.
guide.difficultyAffectsRaw: No, can do everything on Story difficulty
guide.freeRoam: Yes, there is free-roam, but cannot revisit the prologue area & final main quest area (missable  Specter  &  Specter Prime  machine scans)

guide.freeRoam: There is Chapter Replay at any time, can still replay everything after story (no free roam though). Everything is still doable via Chapter Replay, except Coffins/Hidden Statues which must be found in a single playthrough.

It’s highly recommended to make a PS+ Cloud backup save before picking up the last item/collectible of a category. If trophy doesn’t unlock, try reinstalling the game and restore save from PS+ cloud.

The trophy is obtainable but individual collectibles sometimes don’t increase the map counter, if this happens it voids the 100% completion (especially Hunter Blinds are affected).

guide.glitchedRaw: 2 –   Berserker is obtainable but can glitch for some players, especially if buying upgrades across different chapters. Keep all Gold and buy everything in one go at the end of the game. Make a PS+ backup save beforehand as a precaution.   Essentially Unstoppable can glitch if you restart checkpoints immediately after getting a Demonic Essence before reaching the next checkpoint. Then the counter can get stuck at 0 and replaying the chapter doesn’t fix it. So: keep all gold and avoid restarting checkpoints.
